description:
After 2024, Democrats turned to Hasan Piker for answers on how to reach young men and embrace the internet. Now, a top centrist think tank is publishing op-eds saying the party is getting too cozy with him.

Vox's Astead Herndon sits down with both Jonathan Cowan of Third Way and Piker himself to get into the fight that is dividing the Democratic Party.

author: Vox
description:
Sean talks with writer Sigal Samuel about AI successionism, the growing movement that sees artificial intelligence as humanity’s rightful successor. They discuss why some people in the AI world think humanity should be replaced, how this vision borrows from old religious ideas about salvation and transcendence, and why artificial intelligence is a dangerous thing to worship.
